Thus, we have :\n\n* **amount** | Payment amount `(&gt;= 100 XOF)` | Integer | `Obligatory`\n* **currency** | Currency of payment (XOF - XAF - CND - GNF - USD) | String | `Obligatory`\n* **Transaction_id** | The transaction identifier. It must be unique for each transaction| `Obligatory`.\n* **description** | The description of your payment| `Obligatory`.\n* **channels** | The payment universe. Can be: `ALL` - `MOBILE_MONEY` - `CREDIT_CARD` - `WALLET`. Default: `'ALL'` Any combination is applicable to comma separated: `'MOBILE_MONEY, WALLET'` | Character string | Optional\n* **metadata** | String | Optional\n* **customer_name** | Customer name `*` | Character string | Optional\n* **customer_surname** | First name of the buyer `*` | String | Optional\n* **customer_email** | Buyer's email address `*` | String | Optional\n* **customer_phone_number** | Buyer's phone number `*` | String | Optional\n* **customer_city** | Buyer's city `*` | Character string | Optional\n* **customer_country** | Buyer's country. ISO2 country code (CI =&gt; Ivory Coast). Optional\n* **customer_state** | String| Buyer's state (when USA is used as country) `*` | String | Optional\n* **customer_zip_code** | Buyer's Zip Code `*` | Character string | Optional \n&gt; **Note** : `*` Mandatory if using the banking universe (CREDIT_CARD)\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### JavaScript Payment Integration with CinetPay SDK\n\nSource: https://docs.cinetpay.com/api/1.0-en/sdk/js\n\nThis snippet shows how to configure and use the CinetPay SDK in JavaScript to initiate a payment. initialize a payment transaction. You need to provide payment details such as amount, currency, transaction ID, description, and URLs for return and notification.\n\n```APIDOC\n## POST /payment/initialize\n\n### Description\nInitializes a payment transaction with CinetPay.\n\n### Method\nPOST\n\n### Endpoint\n/payment/initialize\n\n### Parameters\n#### Request Body\n- **amount** (integer) - Required - The amount of the transaction.\n- **currency** (string) - Required - The currency code for the transaction (e.g., \"XOF\").\n- **transaction_id** (string) - Required - A unique identifier for the transaction.\n- **description** (string) - Required - A description of the transaction.\n- **return_url** (string) - Required - The URL to redirect the user to after payment.\n- **notify_url** (string) - Required - The URL to receive payment notifications.\n- **customer_name** (string) - Optional - The name of the customer.\n- **customer_surname** (string) - Optional - The surname of the customer.\n\n### Request Example\n```json\n{\n  \"amount\": 10000,\n  \"currency\": \"XOF\",\n  \"transaction_id\": \"TX123456789\",\n  \"description\": \"Payment for order #123\",\n  \"return_url\": \"https://www.example.com/return\",\n  \"notify_url\": \"https://www.example.com/notify\",\n  \"customer_name\": \"John\",\n  \"customer_surname\": \"Doe\"\n}\n```\n\n### Response\n#### Success Response (200)\n- **payment_url** (string) - The URL where the user can complete the payment.\n- **transaction_id** (string) - The unique transaction ID.\n- **status** (string) - The status of the transaction initialization.\n\n#### Response Example\n```json\n{\n  \"payment_url\": \"https://checkout.cinetpay.com/pay?token=abcdef12345\",\n  \"transaction_id\": \"TX123456789\",\n  \"status\": \"pending\"\n}\n```\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Android Permissions and Configuration for CinetPay\n\nSource: https://docs.cinetpay.com/api/1.0-en/sdk/flutter\n\nThis snippet shows the necessary Android permissions and application configuration required for the CinetPay SDK to function correctly, including internet access and enabling cleartext traffic.\n\n```xml\n&lt;application\n        ... \n        android:usesCleartextTraffic=\"true\"&gt;\n        ...\n    &lt;/application&gt;\n    ...\n    &lt;uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.INTERNET\"/&gt;\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Return URL Handling\n\nSource: https://docs.cinetpay.com/api/1.0-en/checkout/retour\n\nAfter a payment, CinetPay redirects the customer to the specified return URL. This endpoint should accept POST requests, primarily for receiving the transaction ID.\n\n### Method\nPOST\n\n### Endpoint\n/return_url\n\n### Parameters\n#### Request Body\n- **transaction_id** (string) - Required - The unique identifier for the transaction.\n\n### Response\n#### Success Response (200)\n- **status** (string) - Indicates the success or failure of the transaction.\n- **message** (string) - A user-friendly message regarding the transaction status.\n\n#### Response Example\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"success\",\n  \"message\": \"Your payment was successful.\"\n}\n```\n\n## Testing the Return URL\n\n### Description\nInstructions on how to test the configured return URL using an HTTP request application like Postman.\n\n### Method\nGET and POST\n\n### Endpoint\n[Your configured return_url]\n\n### Test Steps\n**For GET requests:**\n1. Enter your notification URL in the request application.\n2. Select the GET method and click \"Send\".\n3. Expect a Status 200 OK.\n4. Use the \"preview\" option to view the page.\n\n**For POST requests:**\n1. Enter your notification URL.\n2. Select the POST method.\n3. Set the Content-Type to `x-www-form-urlencoded`.\n4. Include the **transaction_id** in the request body and click \"Send\".\n5. Expect a Status 200 OK.\n6. Use the \"preview\" option to view the page.\n\n### Notes\n- **Session Management**: Use the `metadata` variable during initialization to pass session information and avoid re-login issues upon return.\n- **307 Redirect Errors**: If encountering 307 redirects, check server restrictions (e.g., O2switch's \"Default Security\" option) and disable them if necessary.\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### CinetPay API Payment Method Parameter Example\n\nSource: https://docs.cinetpay.com/api/1.0-en/transfert/utilisation\n\nThis snippet shows how to specify a payment method, such as 'WAVECI', when making a money transfer request via the CinetPay API. --lobe-markdown-header-multiple: 1; --lobe-markdown-line-height: 1.8; --lobe-markdown-margin-multiple: 2;\"><p>CinetPay Payment Integration is a single-hub payment gateway designed for merchants operating in Francophone West and Central Africa. It consolidates 40+ payment methods — including mobile money wallets (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Flooz, T‑Money), major card networks (Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, AmEx, UnionPay) and regional e‑wallets — across 9+ countries, with native support for XOF/FCFA. Use it to add mobile‑money acceptance, expand multi‑country e‑commerce, enable direct mobile money settlements to merchant accounts, and implement card‑based recurring billing for SaaS. Prebuilt plugins exist for WooCommerce, PrestaShop, WHMCS and Moodle. Authentication relies on a secure apikey and numeric site_id obtained from the merchant panel; store credentials in environment variables. Best for West African merchants — not recommended for primarily English‑speaking African markets or use cases requiring real‑time payout verification due to settlement delays.</p></article></div><div class=\"ant-collapse ant-collapse-icon-placement-end ant-collapse-ghost acss-n850tl css-1pi45l5 css-var-_r_a_\" style=\"gap: 0px;\"><div class=\"ant-collapse-item ant-collapse-item-active\"><div class=\"ant-collapse-header ant-collapse-collapsible-header\"><div class=\"ant-collapse-expand-icon\" role=\"button\" aria-expanded=\"true\" aria-disabled=\"false\" tabindex=\"0\"><span class=\"anticon acss-6fcnao ant-collapse-arrow\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-chevron-down\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"m6 9 6 6 6-6\"></path></svg></span></div><span class=\"ant-collapse-title\" role=\"button\" aria-expanded=\"true\" aria-disabled=\"false\" tabindex=\"0\"><div class=\"acss-1gnbjzz\">SKILL.md</div></span></div><div class=\"ant-collapse-panel ant-collapse-panel-active\"><div class=\"ant-collapse-body\"><div data-orientation=\"vertical\" class=\"lobe-flex acss-e07kvn\" data-bottom-scroll=\"true\" style=\"--lobe-flex-height: 240px; 18h-4c0-4 4-3 4-6 0-1.5-2-2.5-4-1\"></path></svg></span></a></h2>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"1-fcfa-currency-handling-is-critical\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">1. <strong>FCFA Currency Handling is Critical</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#1-fcfa-currency-handling-is-critical\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>CinetPay operates exclusively in <strong>West African CFA Franc (XOF)</strong> or local currencies. If your business operates in USD/EUR, you <strong>must convert at prevailing exchange rates before sending</strong>. CinetPay will not accept or convert currencies dynamically. Example: <code>amount = usd_price * 650</code> (approximate rate; use live rates in production).</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"2-transaction-i-ds-must-be-unique-globally\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">2. <strong>Transaction IDs Must Be Unique Globally</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#2-transaction-i-ds-must-be-unique-globally\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Every payment request requires a unique <code>transaction_id</code>. Reusing transaction IDs will either be rejected or cause duplicate payments. Use format: <code>TXN-{timestamp}-{uuid}</code> or <code>TXN-{increment}-{date}</code>. Store transaction IDs in your database immediately after generating them.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"3-webhook-is-notification-only-not-confirmation\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">3. <strong>Webhook is Notification Only, Not Confirmation</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#3-webhook-is-notification-only-not-confirmation\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>CinetPay's webhook tells you payment status changed, <strong>but you must always call the verification API</strong> (<code>/v2/payment/check</code>) to confirm actual payment status. Man-in-the-middle attacks or network spoofing could fake webhook data. Never trust webhook data alone for fulfilling orders.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"4-customer-phone-number-format-is-strict\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">4. <strong>Customer Phone Number Format is Strict</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#4-customer-phone-number-format-is-strict\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Phone numbers must include country code (e.g., <code>+225XXXXXXXXXX</code> for Côte d'Ivoire). Without the leading <code>+</code> and country code, mobile money payments may fail silently. Validate and normalize phone numbers before sending: <code>+{country_code}{number}</code>.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"5-language-parameter-affects-mobile-money-provider-display\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">5. <strong>Language Parameter Affects Mobile Money Provider Display</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#5-language-parameter-affects-mobile-money-provider-display\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Setting <code>\"lang\": \"FR\"</code> shows payment interface in French and may prioritize French-language providers (Orange Money, Moov). Setting <code>\"lang\": \"EN\"</code> shows English and may prioritize English-supporting methods. For Francophone markets, use <code>\"FR\"</code> for better UX.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"6-settlement-delays-are-standard-24-48-hours\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">6. <strong>Settlement Delays Are Standard (24-48 Hours)</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#6-settlement-delays-are-standard-24-48-hours\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>CinetPay settles funds to your merchant account within 24-48 hours, not immediately. If a customer contacts support 1 hour after payment saying \"I haven't received my item,\" you must still mark the order as pending until CinetPay confirms settlement. Track settlement status in your merchant dashboard separately from payment verification.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"7-country-codes-must-match-payment-method-available\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">7. <strong>Country Codes Must Match Payment Method Available</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#7-country-codes-must-match-payment-method-available\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Not all payment methods are available in all countries. Example:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Orange Money is available in: CI, SN, ML, GN</li>\n<li>MTN MoMo is available in: CM, CI, BJ, TG, BF</li>\n<li>Moov Money is available in: TG, BJ, CM, SN</li>\n</ul>\n<p>If you send <code>country: \"SN\"</code> with <code>channels: \"ALL\"</code>, only Senegal-available methods appear. Verify country code matches available methods or use <code>channels: \"ALL\"</code> and let CinetPay filter.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"8-return-url-redirect-is-not-reliable-for-payment-confirmation\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">8. <strong>Return URL Redirect is Not Reliable for Payment Confirmation</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#8-return-url-redirect-is-not-reliable-for-payment-confirmation\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Customers may close the browser after payment before being redirected. <strong>Never rely on return_url callbacks to confirm payment</strong>. Only use <code>notify_url</code> (server-to-server webhook) and the verification API. The return_url is purely for user experience.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"9-rate-limiting-100-requests-per-minute-per-api-key\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">9. <strong>Rate Limiting: 100 Requests Per Minute Per API Key</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#9-rate-limiting-100-requests-per-minute-per-api-key\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>CinetPay applies rate limits. If you exceed ~100 requests/minute, subsequent requests will be throttled. Batch verification requests and implement exponential backoff. Cache verification results when possible.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"10-metadata-and-custom-fields-are-silently-truncated\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">10. <strong>Metadata and Custom Fields Are Silently Truncated</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#10-metadata-and-custom-fields-are-silently-truncated\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Fields like <code>invoice_data</code>, <code>metadata</code>, and <code>description</code> have length limits (typically 255 chars). Longer values are silently truncated without error. Always validate field lengths before sending or risk losing important information.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"11-service-id-site-id-must-match-service-type\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">11. <strong>Service ID (site_id) Must Match Service Type</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#11-service-id-site-id-must-match-service-type\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Each <code>site_id</code> is tied to a specific service (e.g., \"Payments\", \"Transfers\", \"Subscriptions\"). You cannot use a <code>site_id</code> from the \"Transfers\" service for payment processing. Verify your <code>site_id</code> matches your integration use case in the merchant dashboard.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"12-seamless-integration-vs-checkout-differs-significantly\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">12. <strong>Seamless Integration vs. Checkout Differs Significantly</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#12-seamless-integration-vs-checkout-differs-significantly\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>CinetPay offers two integration modes:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Standard (Checkout)</strong>: Redirect to CinetPay-hosted page (this guide)</li>\n<li><strong>Seamless (SDK)</strong>: Embedded payment form in your site (requires JavaScript SDK)</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Seamless is faster but requires frontend SDK. Checkout is easier but requires redirect. Choose based on UX requirements, not interchangeably.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"13-test-vs-production-environment\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">13. <strong>Test vs. Production Environment</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#13-test-vs-production-environment\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Same API key works for <strong>both test and production</strong>. To test:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Use test credentials (API key + site_id configured for test)</li>\n<li>Test notifications by simulating webhook calls</li>\n<li>Verify with test transactions before going live</li>\n<li>Production uses same endpoints; no URL changes needed</li>\n</ol>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"14-hmac-token-verification-implementation-may-vary\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">14. <strong>HMAC Token Verification Implementation May Vary</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#14-hmac-token-verification-implementation-may-vary\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>CinetPay includes an <code>X-TOKEN</code> header in webhook requests for HMAC verification. However, HMAC implementation details vary by documentation version. Always verify transactions directly with the API regardless of token validity.</p>\n<h3 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"15-payment-methods-depend-on-customer-s-mobile-operator\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">15. <strong>Payment Methods Depend on Customer's Mobile Operator</strong><a aria-label=\"Permalink for this section\" class=\"title-anchor acss-156hytl\" href=\"#15-payment-methods-depend-on-customer-s-mobile-operator\" style=\"scroll-margin-top: 96px;\"><span class=\"anticon\" role=\"img\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1em\" height=\"1em\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"transparent\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"M4 12h8\"></path><path d=\"M4 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M12 18V6\"></path><path d=\"M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2\"></path><path d=\"M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2\"></path></svg></span></a></h3>\n<p>Even if <code>channels: \"MOBILE\"</code> is set, customer's actual payment method options depend on their SIM card operator. A customer with Vodafone (no partnership) might not see any mobile money option despite requesting mobile channel. Design your UX to handle empty payment method lists gracefully.</p>\n<hr>\n<h2 class=\"acss-7f8e2k\" id=\"useful-links\" style=\"color: var(--ant-color-text);\">Useful Links<a aria-label=\"Permalink der AI Agents haben 2026 zwei Namen besondere Aufmerksamkeit erlangt: **LobeHub** und **Manus**. Beide versprechen, Ihnen eine AI bereitzustellen, die in der Welt handeln kann — nicht nur chatten — unterscheiden sich jedoch deutlich in Fokus, Besitzmodell und Ökosystem. Ob Sie Entwickler, kreative Fachkraft oder Business‑Nutzer sind: Dieser Vergleich von LobeHub vs Manus hilft Ihnen zu entscheiden, welche Plattform besser zu Ihren Bedürfnissen passt.\\n\\n## Was ist LobeHub?\\n\\nLobeHub ist eine Open‑Source‑AI Agent‑Plattform mit der Vision, „das weltweit größte Mensch‑Agent‑ko‑evolvierende Netzwerk“ aufzubauen. Mit über **73.800 GitHub‑Sternen** und einem Marktplatz mit **217.527+ Skills** und **39.603+ MCP Servers** ist LobeHub eines der umfassendsten AI Agent‑Ökosysteme, die heute verfügbar sind.\\n\\nLobeHub ermöglicht es Ihnen, Agents mit einem einzigen Satz zu erstellen, mehrere Agents zu Teams zusammenzufassen und sie über Skills und den MCP‑Marktplatz praktisch mit jedem Tool oder Service zu verbinden. Die Plattform bietet White‑Box Memory, das Ihre Präferenzen im Laufe der Zeit lernt, multimodale Workflows (Pages, Projects, Schedules) und Unterstützung für beliebige LLMs — OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Mistral oder lokale Modelle.\\n\\nLobeHub bietet eine kostenlose Cloud‑Stufe, eine Community Edition zur Selbst‑Hostung und eine macOS‑Desktop‑App. Es wird von Ingenieur\\\\*innen und Teams bei Google, ByteDance, AWS Bedrock und Alibaba Cloud genutzt.\\n\\n## Was ist Manus?\\n\\nManus („Hands On AI“) ist eine AI Agent‑Plattform, die Anfang 2025 viral ging, weil sie komplexe Aufgaben autonom erledigen kann: Web‑Apps bauen, AI‑Designs generieren, Präsentationen erstellen, recherchieren, E‑Mails verwalten und sich in Slack integrieren. Manus kann Ihren Browser übernehmen und ihn in Ihrem Auftrag steuern.\\n\\nIn einer bedeutenden Entwicklung wurde **Manus 2025 von Meta übernommen**, wodurch seine AI‑Fähigkeiten in das Meta‑Ökosystem integriert wurden. Das verleiht Manus starke Unterstützung für Unternehmenseinsätze weltweit. Manus bietet Web‑App, Mobile‑App, Desktop‑App und einen Browser‑Operator für autonome Web‑Interaktionen. Es richtet sich an Einzelpersonen und Business‑Teams und bietet Pläne für Teams, SSO und API‑Zugriff.\\n\\n## Funktionsvergleich\\n\\n| Feature                 | LobeHub                                  | Manus                           |\\n| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |\\n| **Kernansatz**          | Kollaboratives Agent‑Ökosystem           | Autonome Aufgabenausführung     |\\n| **Open Source**         | ✅ Ja (73,8K Sterne)                      | ❌ Proprietär (Meta‑eigen)       |\\n| **Agent‑Marktplatz**    | ✅ 217.527+ Skills, 39.603+ MCPs          | ❌ Begrenzt                      |\\n| **Multi‑Agent Groups**  | ✅ Auto‑Team‑Formation, parallele Kollab  | ⚠️ Fokus auf Einzel‑Agents      |\\n| **Persönliches Memory** | ✅ White‑Box, kontinuierliches Lernen     | ⚠️ Kontext pro Sitzung          |\\n| **Browser‑Automation**  | ✅ Via MCP/Skills                         | ✅ Integrierter Browser‑Operator |\\n| **Modellunterstützung** | ✅ Beliebiges LLM (OpenAI, Claude, lokal) | ⚠️ Plattform‑kontrolliert       |\\n| **Self‑Hosting**        | ✅ Community Edition                      | ❌ Nur Cloud                     |\\n| **Eigentum**            | Unabhängig, Open‑Source                  | Meta (Übernahme 2025)           |\\n\\n## Preisgestaltung\\n\\n**LobeHub** bietet eine kostenlose Stufe mit Compute‑Guthaben zum Ausführen von Agents. Die selbst‑gehostete Community Edition ist komplett kostenlos. Kostenpflichtige Pläne skalieren mit Nutzung.\\n\\n**Manus** hat Preispläne für Einzelpersonen und Teams. Als Meta‑Produkt kann sich die Preisgestaltung mit der Zeit stärker auf Enterprise‑Kunden konzentrieren.\\n\\n## Anwendungsfälle\\n\\nWählen Sie **LobeHub**, wenn Sie:\\n\\n- Ein reichhaltiges Ökosystem von AI Agents aufbauen und anpassen möchten, das auf Ihren Workflow zugeschnitten ist\\n- Beliebige Sprachmodelle nutzen wollen, einschließlich kostenloser lokaler Modelle\\n- Selbst hosten möchten für vollständige Privatsphäre und Datenkontrolle\\n- Einen riesigen Marktplatz mit 200.000+ Skills nutzen möchten\\n- Ihre AI‑Tools unabhängig von großen Tech‑Konzernen halten möchten\\n\\nWählen Sie **Manus**, wenn Sie:\\n\\n- Komplexe autonome Aufgaben sofort aus der Box ausführen wollen\\n- Ein ausgereiftes, unternehmensbereites Produkt mit Meta‑Infrastruktur bevorzugen\\n- Native Browser‑Operator‑Funktionen für komplette Web‑Automatisierung benötigen\\n- SSO und unternehmensgerechte Sicherheitsfunktionen für Ihr Team wollen\\n\\n## Fazit\\n\\nLobeHub bietet mehrere entscheidende Vorteile: Es ist **Open‑Source**, **selbst‑hostbar**, modell‑agnostisch und community‑getrieben. Sein Marktplatz mit über 217.000 Skills ist unübertroffen, und das White‑Box Memory‑System schafft eine wirklich personalisierte AI, die mit Ihnen wächst.\\n\\nMit Manus unter Meta‑Dach werden einige Nutzer berechtigte Bedenken wegen Datenschutz und Produktentwicklung haben. \\\"transaction_id\\\": \\\"TXN-20250224143022-a1b2c3d4\\\"\\n}\\n```\\n\\n**Verification Example**:\\n\\n```python\\ndef verify_transaction(transaction_id):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Verify a transaction    result = response.json()\\n\\n        if result.get(\\\"code\\\") == \\\"00\\\":\\n            transaction_data = result.get(\\\"data\\\", {})\\n            status = \\\"verified\\\": True,\\n                \\\"status\\\": status,\\n                \\\"amount\\\": transaction_data.get(\\\"amount\\\"),\\n                \\\"currency\\\":  print(f\\\"✗ API error: {str(e)}\\\")\\n        return {\\\"verified\\\": False, \\\"error\\\": str(e)}\\n\\n# Usage after receiving webhook notification\\ntransaction_status = \\\"cpm_phone_prefill\\\": \\\"+225XXXXXXXXXX\\\",\\n    \\\"cpm_customer_name\\\": \\\"John Doe\\\",\\n    \\\"cpm_customer_email\\\": \\\"john@example.com\\\",\\n    \\\"fund_availability_date\\\": \\\"2025-02-25\\\"\\n  }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Webhooks / Notification Handling\\n\\nCinetPay delivers transaction notifications to your `notify_url` when payment status changes.\\n\\n### Webhook Payload Structure\\n\\n**Method**: `POST`\\n**Authentication**: HMAC token in `X-TOKEN` header\\n**Payload Parameter**: `cpm_trans_id` (transaction ID)\\n\\n```python\\n# Your webhook endpoint (Flask example)\\nfrom flask import Flask, request\\nimport hmac\\nimport hashlib\\nimport requests\\nimport json\\n\\napp = Flask(__name__)\\n\\n@app.route('/webhooks/cinetpay', methods=['POST', 'GET'])\\ndef cinetpay_webhook():\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Handle CinetPay webhook notifications\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    # Method 1: Extract transaction ID from request\\n    transaction_id = print(f\\\"✓ Order {transaction_id} status updated to: {status}\\\")\\n```\\n\\n### Webhook Requirements\\n\\n- **Must accept POST and GET** requests\\n- **Must be publicly accessible** (https recommended)\\n- **Must respond with 200 OK** even if processing fails (so CinetPay stops retrying)\\n- **Must call verification API** — webhook data is for notification only, not for confirmation\\n- **CinetPay may retry** the notification multiple times; implement idempotency\\n- **Security**: Validate HMAC token in `X-TOKEN` header if present\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Common Integration Patterns\\n\\n### Pattern 1: Mobile Money Payment (Mobile-First)\\n\\n```python\\n# Scenario: User on mobile app buying digital content\\n\\ndef create_mobile_money_payment(user_email, amount_xof,         \\\"name\\\": \\\"Customer\\\",\\n            \\\"surname\\\": \\\"Name\\\",\\n            \\\"email\\\": user_email,\\n            \\\"phone_number\\\": \\\"+225XXXXXXXXXX\\\",\\n |\\n| `201` | CREATED | Transaction created (pending) | Wait for webhook notification |\\n| `600` | PAYMENT_FAILED | Payment processing failed | Verify customer has sufficient balance; retry |\\n| `602` | INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE | Customer balance too low | Customer must top up wallet |\\n| `608` | MINIMUM_REQUIRED_FIELDS | Missing required parameter | Check all mandatory fields in request |\\n| `609` | AUTH_NOT_FOUND | Invalid API key | Verify API key from merchant panel |\\n| `613` | ERROR_SITE_ID_NOTVALID | Invalid site_id | Verify site_id from merchant panel |\\n| `627` | TRANSACTION_CANCEL | User cancelled payment | Inform customer; allow retry |\\n| `701` | INVALID_CREDENTIALS | Login credentials wrong | Check API key and site_id |\\n| `706` | INVALID_TOKEN | Payment token invalid/expired | Reinitialize payment |\\n| `723` | NOT_FOUND | Transaction not found | Verify transaction_id is correct |\\n\\n### Error Handling Best Practices\\n\\n```python\\ndef safe_api_call(endpoint, payload, max_retries=3):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Safely call CinetPay API with retry logic\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    import time\\n\\n    for attempt in range(max_retries):\\n        try:\\n            response = requests.post(\\n                endpoint,\\n                json=payload,\\n                headers={\\\"Content-Type\\\": \\\"application/json\\\"},\\n                timeout=10\\n            )\\n            response.raise_for_status()\\n\\n            result = response.json()\\n\\n            # Check CinetPay error code\\n            if result.get(\\\"code\\\") == \\\"00\\\":\\n                return {\\\"success\\\": True, \\\"data\\\": result}\\n\\n            # Retryable errors\\n            elif result.get(\\\"code\\\") in [\\\"201\\\", \\\"627\\\"]:\\n                if attempt \\u003c max_retries - 1:\\n                    time.sleep(2 ** attempt)  # Exponential backoff\\n                    continue\\n                return {\\\"success\\\": False, \\\"retryable\\\": True, \\\"error\\\": result}\\n\\n            # Non-retryable errors\\n            else:\\n                return {\\\"success\\\": False, \\\"retryable\\\": False, \\\"error\\\": result}\\n\\n        except requests.exceptions.Timeout:\\n            if attempt \\u003c max_retries - 1:\\n                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)\\n                continue\\n            return {\\\"success\\\": False, \\\"retryable\\\": True, \\\"error\\\": \\\"Timeout after retries\\\"}\\n\\n        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:\\n            return {\\\"success\\\": False, \\\"retryable\\\": False, \\\"error\\\": str(e)}\\n\\n    return {\\\"success\\\": False, \\\"retryable\\\": False, \\\"error\\\": \\\"Max retries exceeded\\\"}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Important Notes \\u0026 Gotchas\\n\\n### 1. **FCFA Currency Handling is Critical**\\nCinetPay operates exclusively in **West African CFA Franc (XOF)** or local currencies. If your business operates in USD/EUR, you **must convert at prevailing exchange rates before sending**. CinetPay will not accept or convert currencies dynamically. Example: `amount = usd_price * 650` (approximate rate; use live rates in production).\\n\\n### 2. **Transaction IDs Must Be Unique Globally**\\nEvery payment request requires a unique `transaction_id`. Reusing transaction IDs will either be rejected or cause duplicate payments. Use format: `TXN-{timestamp}-{uuid}` or `TXN-{increment}-{date}`. Store transaction IDs in your database immediately after generating them.\\n\\n### 3. **Webhook is Notification Only, Not Confirmation**\\nCinetPay's webhook tells you payment status changed, **but you must always call the verification API** (`/v2/payment/check`) to confirm actual payment status. Man-in-the-middle attacks or network spoofing could fake webhook data. Never trust webhook data alone for fulfilling orders.\\n\\n### 4. **Customer Phone Number Format is Strict**\\nPhone numbers must include country code (e.g., `+225XXXXXXXXXX` for Côte d'Ivoire). Without the leading `+` and country code, mobile money payments may fail silently. Validate and normalize phone numbers before sending: `+{country_code}{number}`.\\n\\n### 5. **Language Parameter Affects Mobile Money Provider Display**\\nSetting `\\\"lang\\\": \\\"FR\\\"` shows payment interface in French and may prioritize French-language providers (Orange Money, Moov). Setting `\\\"lang\\\": \\\"EN\\\"` shows English and may prioritize English-supporting methods. For Francophone markets, use `\\\"FR\\\"` for better UX.\\n\\n### 6. **Settlement Delays Are Standard (24-48 Hours)**\\nCinetPay settles funds to your merchant account within 24-48 hours, not immediately. If a customer contacts support 1 hour after payment saying \\\"I haven't received my item,\\\" you must still mark the order as pending until CinetPay confirms settlement. Track settlement status in your merchant dashboard separately from payment verification.\\n\\n### 7. **Country Codes Must Match Payment Method Available**\\nNot all payment methods are available in all countries. Example:\\n- Orange Money is available in: CI, SN, ML, GN\\n- MTN MoMo is available in: CM, CI, BJ, TG, BF\\n- Moov Money is available in: TG, BJ, CM, SN\\n\\nIf you send `country: \\\"SN\\\"` with `channels: \\\"ALL\\\"`, only Senegal-available methods appear. Verify country code matches available methods or use `channels: \\\"ALL\\\"` and let CinetPay filter.\\n\\n### 8. **Return URL Redirect is Not Reliable for Payment Confirmation**\\nCustomers may close the browser after payment before being redirected. **Never rely on return_url callbacks to confirm payment**. Only use `notify_url` (server-to-server webhook) and the verification API. The return_url is purely for user experience.\\n\\n### 9. **Rate Limiting: 100 Requests Per Minute Per API Key**\\nCinetPay applies rate limits. If you exceed ~100 requests/minute, subsequent requests will be throttled. Batch verification requests and implement exponential backoff. Cache verification results when possible.\\n\\n### 10. **Metadata and Custom Fields Are Silently Truncated**\\nFields like `invoice_data`, `metadata`, and `description` have length limits (typically 255 chars). Longer values are silently truncated without error. Always validate field lengths before sending or risk losing important information.\\n\\n### 11. **Service ID (site_id) Must Match Service Type**\\nEach `site_id` is tied to a specific service (e.g., \\\"Payments\\\", \\\"Transfers\\\", \\\"Subscriptions\\\"). You cannot use a `site_id` from the \\\"Transfers\\\" service for payment processing. Verify your `site_id` matches your integration use case in the merchant dashboard.\\n\\n### 12. **Seamless Integration vs. Checkout Differs Significantly**\\nCinetPay offers two integration modes:\\n- **Standard (Checkout)**: Redirect to CinetPay-hosted page (this guide)\\n- **Seamless (SDK)**: Embedded payment form in your site (requires JavaScript SDK)\\n\\nSeamless is faster but requires frontend SDK. Checkout is easier but requires redirect. Choose based on UX requirements, not interchangeably.\\n\\n### 13. **Test vs. Production Environment**\\nSame API key works for **both test and production**. To test:\\n1. Use test credentials (API key + site_id configured for test)\\n2. Test notifications by simulating webhook calls\\n3. Verify with test transactions before going live\\n4. Production uses same endpoints; no URL changes needed\\n\\n### 14. **HMAC Token Verification Implementation May Vary**\\nCinetPay includes an `X-TOKEN` header in webhook requests for HMAC verification. However, HMAC implementation details vary by documentation version. Always verify transactions directly with the API regardless of token validity.\\n\\n### 15. **Payment Methods Depend on Customer's Mobile Operator**\\nEven if `channels: \\\"MOBILE\\\"` is set, customer's actual payment method options depend on their SIM card operator. A customer with Vodafone (no partnership) might not see any mobile money option despite requesting mobile channel. Design your UX to handle empty payment method lists gracefully.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Useful Links\\n\\n- **Official Documentation**: https://docs.cinetpay.com/\\n- **Payment Initialization Guide**:
